logline: Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 18's devastating fire; Juliana and Alexander stand amidst the morning ruins of Blackwood cottage with her mother's surviving herbal book before retreating to an abandoned barn.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot of Juliana and Alexander standing side by side amidst the charred, smoldering wreckage of their destroyed cottage, thick smoke rising behind them into the overcast sky.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana clutches her mother's scorched leather-bound herbal book against her chest, her face streaked with soot as she stares at the ruin in disbelief.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sorrowful, Hollow)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: This was our home.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the blackened, heat-damaged leather ledger held in Juliana's linen-bandaged hands.

segments.label: JULIANA (Emotional, Fragile)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: My mother's book almost burned with it.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander looking down at Juliana with quiet, stoic concern.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of three villagers approaching through the burnt clearing: an elder villager carrying folded wool blankets, followed by a man and woman holding loaves of baked bread.

segments.label: ELDER VILLAGER (Respectful, Sincere)
segments.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
segments.text: My lady. You cannot stay here.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's tearful, soot-stained face as she listens.

segments.label: ELDER VILLAGER (O.S.)
segments.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
segments.text: There is an old barn near the village. It is empty.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.

segments.label: ELDER VILLAGER (Gentle, Earnest)
segments.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
segments.text: Take it.

segments.label: JULIANA (Hesitant, Humble)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: We cannot ask the village to feed us.

segments.label: ELDER VILLAGER (Warm, Grateful)
segments.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
segments.text: You saved my son's life.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.

segments.label: ELDER VILLAGER (O.S.)
segments.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
segments.text: You saved mine, too.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.

segments.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Solemn)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: We will not forget this kindness.

segments.label: ELDER VILLAGER (Nodding, Earnest)
segments.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
segments.text: Neither will the village.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.

segments.label: JULIANA (Choked Up, Mournful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Goodbye, Blackwood.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.

segments.label: INFORMANT (Subservient, Urgent)
segments.speaker: INFORMANT
segments.text: Your Grace.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Direct)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Tell me what is happening in Ashburg.

segments.label: INFORMANT (Grave, Cautious)
segments.speaker: INFORMANT
segments.text: Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.

segments.label: INFORMANT (O.S.)
segments.speaker: INFORMANT
segments.text: Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.

segments.label: INFORMANT (Earnest)
segments.speaker: INFORMANT
segments.text: And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.

segments.label: INFORMANT (Whispering, Alarmed)
segments.speaker: INFORMANT
segments.text: But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.

segments.label: INFORMANT (O.S.)
segments.speaker: INFORMANT
segments.text: There are almost no loyal servants left around her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.

segments.label: INFORMANT (Grave)
segments.speaker: INFORMANT
segments.text: The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Pained Fury)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.

segments.label: INFORMANT (Quiet, Solemn)
segments.speaker: INFORMANT
segments.text: And everyone believes you are dead.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Lethal, Calculating)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then let them believe it a little longer.

segments.label: INFORMANT (Inquiring, Tense)
segments.speaker: INFORMANT
segments.text: And when we have the proof?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's face, silent tears streaming down her soot-smudged cheeks as her chin quivers.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.

segments.label: JULIANA (O.S.)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: We have lost everything.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.

segments.label: JULIANA (Despairing, Broken)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I don't know what we will do tomorrow.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Soft, Steadfast)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Tomorrow, we begin again.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana turning her tear-drenched eyes up toward Alexander, her face filled with longing and newfound hope.

segments.label: JULIANA (Faint Smile, Emotional)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You make it sound so simple.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow cinematic push-in on the couple nestled together in the warm lantern glow. Alexander wraps his arm firmly around Juliana as she closes her eyes in exhausted relief, while his piercing gaze stares resolutely into the darkness, determined to reclaim everything that was stolen.
